d.seg: I will do a video call on WhatsApp, give three hundred
d.tr: I will do a video call on WhatsApp, give three hundred
d.ctx: The user is talking about how they use the app and then suddenly proposes moving to WhatsApp for a fee. The expert responds by saying it is not their type and expresses disbelief.
d.j: The user proposes moving to an external app (WhatsApp) and requests payment, which constitutes a PlatformMove violation.
